findings.claim: Post-child validation binds the native home only by pathname and expected config bytes. In the actual bubblewrap shape, a worker can rename its writable native-home directory despite per-file read-only binds, recreate the same pinned config bytes at the bound pathname, and put a substituted credential there. The two resolve() operands then resolve the same replacement directory, validation accepts, and carry-back writes the substituted credential into the host store.
